description: This Java class defines the ProgramWorkflowState entity within the OpenMRS healthcare platform, representing a state within a program's workflow, including properties such as concept, initial state, terminal state, and associated program workflow.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowState
classes.description: Represents a specific state within a program's workflow, including properties like concept, initial, terminal, and linkage to the program workflow.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the workflow state, including concept, initial, and terminal properties.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with this workflow state.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with this workflow state.

methods.name: getInitial
methods.description: Returns whether this state is an initial state.

methods.name: setInitial
methods.description: Sets whether this state is an initial state.

methods.name: getTerminal
methods.description: Returns whether this state is a terminal state.

methods.name: setTerminal
methods.description: Sets whether this state is a terminal state.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the program workflow this state belongs to.

methods.name: setProgramWorkflow
methods.description: Associates a program workflow with this state.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStateId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this program workflow state.

methods.name: setProgramWorkflowStateId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this program workflow state.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this entity, overriding the method from OpenMRS Object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this entity, overriding the method from OpenMRS Object.
